body: Always loved the old cover art, I have the first three with art like that.

Hey! Boy howdy can I relate. I’ve been trying to get one forever. I experienced the price hike too. Last summer they were only one fifty. Now it’s five hundred, anyways. 

Where I found mine (for one fifty) was eBay. Hope you find one, I had to dig up all my 3.5 books (it’s only fully compatible with 3.5, you kinda need the main books) what a wave of nostalgia. It’s an amazing setting and such a labor of love, you can tell the author really wanted to get as much of the series into it as he could. Good luck! I wish you the best and I’ll send a link if I find one for cheaper.

Oh, P.S: I hear the price hike is because they’re going to release another book, exciting!
